h1: New weight-loss drugs: the 2025-2026 announcements, and where cagrilintide stands
dek: Three new weight-loss medicines reached US approval between December 2025 and October 2026: the Wegovy pill, Foundayo (orforglipron) and Wegovy HD. Here is each announcement, dated and sourced, with the late-stage pipeline and where cagrilintide fits.
